newsitem.title: FRANCE: Medicine Nobel prizewinner joins French Academy.
newsitem.headline: Medicine Nobel prizewinner joins French Academy.

text.p: Nobel prizewinner for medicine Francois Jacob was elected to the French Academy on Thursday in a rare tribute to science from the prestigious literary body.
The guardians of the French language elected Jacob, 76, to succeed the late novelist Jean-Louis Curtis.
"It's a great honour and a surprise since I am not a literary figure. The Academy elected science and biology rather than myself," Jacob said in a radio interview.
Jacob shared the 1965 Nobel prize with French colleagues Andre Lwoff and Jacques Mondod for their work on cell biology.
